name: WP Engine Staging Deploy
description: Deploys a theme, plugin or mu-plugin to WP Engine staging when a pull request merges into the default branch. Also deploys any branch with Run workflow. Takes a labeled backup (a restore point) before each deploy. Needs the WPE_SSHG_KEY_PRIVATE secret and the WPE_STAGE_ENV variable. For backups, also needs the WPE_API_USER_ID and WPE_API_PASSWORD secrets and the BACKUP_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL variable.
